title: 🧹 Cleaning and anonymizing copies in Business Central: environments, companies, and traceability
summary: A reusable solution for automatically anonymizing sensitive data, marking copied companies, and adjusting settings when copying Business Central environments or companies. It provides table and field configuration, manual or event-triggered execution, and comprehensive logging for audit trails.
key_points: Configure which tables and fields to anonymize using setup tables, with options to anonymize selectively across copies
Leverage standard events (OnClearDatabaseConfig, OnClearCompanyConfig, OnAfterCreatedNewCompanyByCopyCompany) to run cleanup automatically or manually
Mark copied companies visually with [COPY] tag and adjust configuration settings to distinguish test copies from production
Log all cleanup executions with header and detail records showing trigger type, company, start/end times, duration, and individual step results for traceability and audit
features: data anonymization by table and field

quotes.text: An important part of this idea is not only executing the process, but also leaving evidence of the whole process.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the value of comprehensive logging and traceability for audit, support, and operational review
